title: Planned Network Deployments 2026 - Methodology Annex
findings: Existing full-fibre and gigabit-capable coverage as of January 2026 is based on data collected for the Connected Nations Spring 2026 update.
The planned-deployments report uses the same premise-base construction as the Connected Nations Spring 2026 update on existing coverage.
The total premise base in scope is 32.5 million properties, including 30.5 million residential premises.
For the Spring 2026 premise base Ofcom used AddressBase Epoch 123, released in November 2025.
Ofcom combined AddressBase data with the ONS National Statistics Postcode Lookup for November 2025 and Locale urban/rural classifications.
scope_caveat: This methodology annex validates the January 2026/Spring 2026 coverage baseline and premise-base construction but does not provide the corrected-r2 archive bytes, CRCs, or 121 postcode members.
